narrative.overview:
A professional portfolio that traces a path. The page is one continuous journey through a WebGL shader world — indigo night at the hero, dawn behind the experience timeline, dusk violet over the projects, and a quiet aurora at the contact — with a slim waypoint rail on the right edge filling with gold as the visitor descends. The world provides all the atmosphere; the content stays quiet, factual, and typographically calm.

Typography carries the professionalism: Source Serif 4 gives the name and section headings an editorial, confident voice; Manrope keeps every sentence and control precise and unpretentious. One accent — Trail Gold — marks the path itself: waypoint dots, timeline markers, actions, and the rail fill. Nothing shouts, nothing blinks, nothing games.
keyCharacteristics: One evolving shader world — a living domain-warped fBm silk field with a breathing glow and GPU motes, blending through four biomes and quickening with scroll velocity; never a hard cut.
A single warm accent: Trail Gold on the path's markers and actions; the sky owns the big color.
Content in near-opaque dark panels with 14px radii and 1px hairline borders; depth is declared once, as a border.

Restrained, living motion: exponential ease-out entrances, one heading wipe, the timeline trail filling as it is traversed, the hero drifting away as the journey begins, and the silk quickening while you scroll; freezes under prefers-reduced-motion, works without WebGL.

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Trail Gold is the only UI accent. If a screen needs a second accent color, the request is really for the shader's biome palette — add it there, not to the chrome.

rules.name: The Solid Panel Rule
rules.body: Body copy never floats on the animated sky. Reading text lives on Panel surfaces; only the hero sits directly on the world.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Headings Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 appears only on h1/h2 and one italic publication note. Every control, label, and sentence is Manrope.

rules.name: The 0.75rem Floor Rule
rules.body: No text below 12px. The smallest labels still clear contrast over the night world.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: A panel states its elevation once, as a border — never border plus shadow. Hover changes border color, not box-shadow.

dos: Do keep every sentence on a near-opaque Panel; only the hero sits directly on the sky.
Do blend biome palettes continuously through scroll — the world is one traverse, not four decorated sections.
Do keep motion exponential ease-out and restrained: rise + blur entrances, one heading wipe, no blinking.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion (static world, instant reveals) and keep the CSS-gradient fallback world for no-WebGL browsers.
donts: Don't reintroduce gaming vocabulary, pixel fonts, boot sequences, or arcade chrome — the world is professional (user decision, 2026-10-11).
Don't add a second UI accent; new color arrives through the shader's biome palettes.
Don't put text below 0.75rem or animate layout properties.
Don't use Source Serif 4 for controls or sentences — serif is for headings and the one italic note.
Don't add a stats/skills section — removed by user decision.
